content.text: The evidence is clear: the flag `monthly-spend-feature` rolled out (partial at 17:35, full by 17:36) and immediately triggered `ZeroDivisionError` at `spend_summary.py:47`, coinciding exactly with the error rate spike from ~1% baseline to ~30%+.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (partial rollout at 17:35, full by 17:36), and its code path throws a ZeroDivisionError in spend_summary.py, causing account page requests to fail. Error rate jumped from ~1% baseline to ~30-34% in the same minute the flag flipped, with no code deployment and no upstream dependency involved.
